patterns_discovered: Incremental update pattern: Three complementary methods (add, remove, update) providing full CRUD operations on indexed documents
Index rebuild strategy: Full BM25Okapi index reconstruction on each operation rather than incremental updates
Document reconstruction: Helper method reconstructs original document strings from tokenized BM25 corpus
Automatic cache management: _update_cache() automatically invoked after each operation to persist state
Consistent error handling: ValueError raised for missing documents with descriptive messages
Graceful degradation: Index set to None when all documents removed, remains functional
gotchas_discovered: BM25 index stores only tokenized corpus, not original documents - required implementing _get_documents() reconstruction method
Cache update failures are non-fatal: Logged as warning but index remains usable, preventing cascade failures
Full index rebuild on each operation: Potential performance bottleneck with large document sets (not optimized for batch operations)
State synchronization: _paths list and _bm25 index must remain synchronized across all operations
ImportError handling: Repeated in all three methods (add/remove/update) - code duplication opportunity
discoveries.approach_outcome: SUCCESS - Implemented complete incremental index update functionality with comprehensive test coverage. All three update methods follow consistent patterns, integrate cleanly with existing persistence layer, and maintain backward compatibility. Implementation is production-ready with proper error handling and cache management.
recommendations: Optimize for batch operations: Consider batch_add_documents(), batch_remove_documents() to avoid repeated full rebuilds
Extract repeated ImportError handling into a decorator or helper method to reduce code duplication
Add performance profiling tests for large document sets to identify scaling limitations
Document the O(n) rebuild cost in method docstrings to set user expectations
Consider implementing lazy index rebuilds using a deferred update pattern for scenarios with many sequential operations
Add optional progress callback parameter for incremental operations on large collections
